no_record_migration.reason: Decision requests are transient inputs, not stored records. The 1.2.0 schema accepts 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 requests as they are; only a request that declares 1.1.0 and carries media, a field 1.1.0 never defined, is refused (see the 3.3-to-4.0 migration guide).
Results have the same fields at 1.1.0 and 1.2.0, and the 1.2.0 schema accepts stored 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 results unchanged. migrate_decision_result already relabels them on request.
